column1: # The container matrix's known deviations (#1124): one row per x86_64 cell whose verdict is WRONG,
# fails on a held cell with no row (UNLISTED), a row whose verdict differs (CHANGED), a row whose cell
# now passes or traps (STALE: the fix deletes its own row), and a row naming no cell (UNKNOWN).
# A TRAP (the checked-failure `ud2`, rc 132) is a recorded outcome and has no row; any other signal, a
# timeout or a stray exit code is a CRASH and is held (#1277). The verdict holds a WRONG's check code, a
# CRASH's rc and only the kind of a refusal (its message carries absolute paths). Measured at #987's
# fix on main 9e60e8aa on omen, native x86_64, compiler built from this tree: 428 cells, OK=392
# WRONG=0 TRAP=3 CRASH=4 REFUSED=29. 33 rows under 5 open issues: 29 REFUSED (20 #1250, 8 #1280,
# 1 #1249) and 4 CRASH 139 (2 #1608: an `Option` element of `vec::iter`'s slice; 2 #1308: a grown
# OMap of `Option` values). The 15 struct and enum cells of `v[i]`, `v[a..b]` and `v.at(i)` (#987,
# #1256) are gone with #987's fix. The omap, oset, map, strmap, string and strbuf cells (#1278) add 3
# of the rows. The 3 TRAP 132 cells, hashmap.key.{i8,i64,enumN}, are all #1304: the structural hash's
# checked `u64(v)` of a negative leaf. The 25 `char` rows of #1244 are gone: since the x86_64 IR flip
# (#980) those cells build and observe OK.
